BiblicalUsage: Chobereth is a coupling, a joint that holds two things together, and it belongs to the tabernacle curtains. The loops of blue on the edge of one curtain are coupled to the loops on the edge of the other, so that the whole covering hangs as one, and the workmen repeat the coupling exactly as commanded.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the couplings of the tabernacle are a picture of the church, many pieces held together by God's own design. I hold that the joints no one sees are the ones that hold the whole together.
